key_insight: Sim-to-real finetuning can cause severe forgetting in physics foundation models, but replaying just 1% simulated data recovers most lost simulation performance.
engineering_relevance: Lightweight data replay can help preserve simulation capabilities while adapting fluid-dynamics models to experimental measurements.
method: Finetune Walrus-1.3B on simulated flow around a cylinder, then on experimental data.
Evaluate forgetting on original pretraining datasets and the simulated task.
Test simulated-data replay during experimental-data adaptation.
evidence_signal: Simulation finetuning increased one-step errors on pretraining datasets by up to 35× after 20 epochs; 1% simulated-data replay during real-data finetuning recovered most lost simulation performance while retaining effective experimental adaptation.
watch_item: The study examines one model and a cylinder-flow adaptation sequence; replay effectiveness may differ across other models and flow regimes.
paper_title: Frozen in Time: How a Physics Foundation Model Forgets Under Sim-to-Real Adaptation
